neighbours.label: comma closing a fronted 'In addition to / Aside from / Apart from ...' phrase
fire: Apart from the long queues, the museum visit was enjoyable.
In addition to the merger, the board is proposing new rules for staff.
Aside from the sharp claws, these birds had unusually strong legs.
In addition to using huge amounts of power, the plant produces toxic waste.
Apart from a short break in June, the factory ran all year.
In addition to the fee increase, the college plans to cut two courses.
Aside from its size, the new phone looks much like the old one.
In addition to the rail strike, commuters faced heavy snow.
quiet: The museum visit was enjoyable despite the long queues.
The board is proposing new rules for staff after the merger.
These birds had sharp claws and unusually strong legs.
The plant uses huge amounts of power and produces toxic waste.
The factory ran all year with a short break in June.
The college plans to raise fees and cut two courses.
The new phone looks much like the old one but is larger.
Commuters faced a rail strike and heavy snow.
